policy.scope: Public-family mark recovery/localization on source-reviewed natural media. No-added-mark controls are not certified human/original files. Not general deepfake, face-swap, speech or production-provider accuracy.
policy.images: 32 fixed source photos: 10 architecture, 10 food, 6 plants, 6 landscapes; no more than2 images per credited creator. Four states: no_added_mark/full_mark/partial_center/ordinary_rotated_center; native/JPEG70.256 cases.
policy.videos: 8 fixed source camera clips, distinct credited creators;8 sampled frames per clip with exact original PTS and center-crop mapping. No-added-mark/partial/ordinary edit; raw/H264CRF23.384 frame cases. No audio check.
policy.video_truth: Derived2fps sequence only: center128square on sampled frames2:6 is marked or conventionally rotated. Derived1–3s maps to recorded source samples; no examination of unsampled original frames. Codec propagation can affect outside intervals.
policy.payload_assignment: Photo/clip numeric ID modulo4; alternating, all-zero, all-one and fixed SHA256-derived32bit patterns. Input diversity, not a detector/key/threshold change.
policy.point: Unchanged native presence logits strictly>0;8-connected components of at least500pixels flag inspection. Every presence logit, pixel mask and hard bit map retained. A mark does not authenticate an AI generator.
policy.preprocessing: Unchanged publisher ImageNet transform, native F32, scaling_w2 and JND. Full marked output unnormalized/clamped/half-up RGB8. Partial copies marked center pixels only; ordinary edits are center90degree rotation.
policy.storage: Every native presence F32 byte retained losslessly as transposed byte planes; original-byte SHA256 per case. All32 binary prediction maps packed losslessly. No floating precision reduction. Original sources, working arrays, full/partial/ordinary base arrays and H264 clips retained privately.
policy.source_review: All40 selected sources and56 previews reviewed for photographic content before scoring. Metadata dates/licenses are publisher claims; project URL inventories excluded; pretraining overlap unknown.
policy.parity: Four first-photo wrapper/direct comparisons and one exact repeated partial prediction. Every message compared with publisher hard readout. No score-dependent source replacement, point change or omitted case.
policy.reporting: All-source/state/codec totals, source-level any-frame flags and complete marked-interval misses, exact message recovery/unavailability, marked IoU>=0.5 counts, and separate payload/photo-stratum summaries. Variants/frames are correlated; no population accuracy or calibrated confidence inferred.
policy.inference: CPUfloat32,2Torch threads,seed20261108;900seconds,6GiB sampled treeRSS,1536MiB availableRAM/disk guard.

source_panel.scope: No-added-mark/known added-mark controls; photographic development eligibility review, not AI-authorship truth or production-provider compatibility.

publication_redactions: Resource-profile argument paths withheld. Native statistics, policy, audit facts and sampling-error counts unchanged.
limitations: Public watermark presence cannot authenticate a provider or AI authorship.
Frames/variants share sources; no independent-population accuracy or confidence is established.
An outside-interval compressed response can be codec propagation or a false-family response; not proof of an AI edit at that timestamp.
The audit recorded 1 process-sampling error(s); sampled memory is a lower bound, not an exact peak. The caught exception type was not separately recorded.
